scope: Candy Cascade presentation v3 (game-standards §6): spin lock, cumulative meter, escalating win tiers, free-spin total screen, multiplier callouts, simple autoplay. Engine candy-cascade-2 unchanged.

playwright test -c pw-local.tmp.config.ts product.spec.ts solo-lifecycle.spec.ts demo-entropy.spec.ts --workers=1 (temporary config, deleted)

found_and_fixed: CountUp meter dipped below its start value for one frame on every new target (rAF timestamp earlier than performance.now() at effect start -> negative progress). Reproduced by the new monotonic-meter browser assertion (34,40 -> 34,20); fixed by clamping progress to [0,1]; 0 drops after the fix.
limits: Frame rate measured only under software rendering (swiftshader): celebration frames ~80 ms there; 60 fps on a mid-range phone is not verified.
